description: Probe a remote MCP server end-to-end: performs the initialize handshake, captures server info and protocol version, lists its tools, and grades tool-quality the way directories like Glama do — description coverage and depth, input-schema completeness, and naming consistency — with a 0-100 score, letter grade, and per-tool detail. Use it to vet an MCP server before connecting an agent (or paying per call) to it.

url.description: The MCP server endpoint URL, e.g. https://example.com/mcp

name: mcp_server_probe
